# Offline map console component

Independent Python/SQLite application with CesiumJS 1.121.0. Start CONSOLE_CONFIG=config.json CONSOLE_DATABASE=sessions.sqlite CESIUM_ASSET_DIR=/path/to/cesium/Build/Cesium python server.py. Cesium is an external public runtime dependency, including its Workers, Assets and Widgets directories; preserve its Apache-2.0/third-party licenses. The server serves only that designated dependency root and its own public page assets. No external service is contacted, including at first login; loopback HTTP is the local application transport.

Private config supplies users:{username:{name,salt,password_hash}}, locations:[{id,name,latitude,longitude}], and tracks:[{id,name,description,samples:[{time,latitude,longitude}]}]. Credential hashes use Python hashlib.scrypt(password bytes,salt=hex-decoded salt,n=16384,r=8,p=1). Test locations, users and telemetry are independent synthetic fixtures. POST /login accepts username,password; POST /logout revokes the session. GET /me returns the current actor; /locations?q=text, /tracks and /rewind?id=track&at=timezone-aware-ISO8601 require that session. Sessions use an HttpOnly cookie and a hashed token in SQLite.

Repair the supplied local login, search and track-history component while preserving its actual Cesium viewer and local HTTP shell. Search and rewind must move rendered geometry, not just return map-center fields. The two side panels share a grid with the map. Existing fixtures contain no customer maps, imagery, camera streams, locations, application names or device endpoints. A plain ellipsoid and point geometry are used instead of copyrighted/source imagery.

This component tests local authentication, desktop console layout, offline location search and supplied track history. It does not claim a complete device-control platform, camera/video processing, actual sensor tracking, customer server integration or native desktop packaging. The panel grid, UTC fixture format and sample-selection boundary are disclosed reconstruction choices. The test viewport range is 960–1440 CSS pixels.

The prepared python-cesium environment supplies CesiumJS 1.121.0 and its licenses at /opt/sweclar/cesium; CESIUM_ASSET_DIR defaults in that image to /opt/sweclar/cesium/Build/Cesium. No installation or external account is needed. Run python /public_tests/smoke.py for the existing public shell check. For a demo config: python /workspace/dev_runtime/demo_config.py /tmp/console-config.json, then CONSOLE_CONFIG=/tmp/console-config.json CONSOLE_DATABASE=/tmp/console-sessions.sqlite PORT=8080 python server.py; health is GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/.

Local case-insensitive search is already implemented and is a public regression. Panel width allocation and desktop layout are benchmark adaptations; the source requested geographic focus preservation and also specified unchanged map size. Exact sample selection is a reconstruction convention. Required response fields can include additional metadata; successful HTTP status and equivalent timezone representations are not otherwise fixed.
